# Generated by reflex generate cmake
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
if(POLICY CMP0144)
	cmake_policy(SET CMP0144 NEW)
endif()
project(ReflexCLI LANGUAGES C CXX)
if(APPLE)
	enable_language(OBJC OBJCXX)
endif()

set(REFLEX_ROOT "../../..")
include("../../../cmake/ReflexBuild.cmake")
if(NOT COMMAND reflex_add_target)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "CMake build helpers were not provided; configure cmake_find_packages or cmake_includes")
endif()
reflex_detect_platform()
reflex_get_cli(REFLEX_CLI_EXECUTABLE)

if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
	set(REFLEX_ARCHITECTURE x64)
else()
	set(REFLEX_ARCHITECTURE x86)
endif()
if(REFLEX_PLATFORM_IOS AND CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
	set(REFLEX_PLATFORM_VARIANT "$(PLATFORM_NAME)")
else()
	set(REFLEX_PLATFORM_VARIANT "")
endif()

# Imported projects

)

set(REFLEXCLI_COMMON_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${REFLEX_ROOT}/include")

function(reflexcli_apply_common_properties target)
	reflex_target_set_warning_level(${target} standard)
	reflex_target_set_floating_point(${target} default)
	set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY OUTPUT_NAME "reflex")
	reflex_target_set_optimization(${target} none CONFIG Debug)
	reflex_target_set_debug_information(${target} ON CONFIG Debug)
	reflex_target_set_dead_strip(${target} OFF CONFIG Debug)
	reflex_target_set_optimization(${target} size CONFIG Release)
	reflex_target_set_debug_information(${target} OFF CONFIG Release)
	reflex_target_set_dead_strip(${target} ON CONFIG Release)
endfunction()

# ReflexCLI
if(REFLEX_PLATFORM_LINUX OR REFLEX_PLATFORM_MACOS OR REFLEX_PLATFORM_WINDOWS)
	reflex_add_target(ReflexCLI TYPE CONSOLE)
	reflexcli_apply_common_properties(ReflexCLI)
	reflex_target_set_cpp_standard(ReflexCLI cxx20)
	reflex_target_enable_string_pooling(ReflexCLI)
	target_sources(ReflexCLI PRIVATE ${REFLEXCLI_COMMON_SOURCES})
	target_include_directories(ReflexCLI PRIVATE ${REFLEXCLI_COMMON_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
	reflex_target_set_runtime_library(ReflexCLI static
		DEBUG_CONFIGS
			Debug
	)
	target_compile_definitions(ReflexCLI PRIVATE "REFLEX_BOOTSTRAP_TYPE_CONSOLE_APP")
	if(REFLEX_PLATFORM_LINUX)
		target_link_libraries(ReflexCLI PRIVATE
			"curl"
			"dl"
			"m"
			"pthread"
		)
		reflex_target_set_rtti(ReflexCLI OFF)
		reflex_target_set_output_directory(ReflexCLI "output/linux/Debug/${REFLEX_ARCHITECTURE}/ReflexCLI" CONFIG Debug)
		reflex_target_set_output_directory(ReflexCLI "output/linux/Release/${REFLEX_ARCHITECTURE}/ReflexCLI" CONFIG Release)
		target_sources(ReflexCLI PRIVATE "${REFLEX_ROOT}/src/reflex/system/linux_console.cpp")
		reflex_target_add_build_action(ReflexCLI
			PHASE POST_BUILD
			NAME "Create install directory"
			WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
			CONFIG Debug
			COMMAND
				"mkdir"
				"-p"
				"${REFLEX_ROOT}/bin/tools/linux"
		)
		reflex_target_add_build_action(ReflexCLI
			PHASE POST_BUILD
			NAME "Install"
			WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
			CONFIG Debug
			COMMAND
				"cp"
				"-f"
				"output/linux/Debug/${REFLEX_ARCHITECTURE}/ReflexCLI/reflex"
				"${REFLEX_ROOT}/bin/tools/linux/reflex"
			INPUTS
				"output/linux/Debug/${REFLEX_ARCHITECTURE}/ReflexCLI/reflex"

			PHASE POST_BUILD
			NAME "Create install directory"
			WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"

				"mkdir"

				"${REFLEX_ROOT}/bin/tools/linux"
		)

			PHASE POST_BUILD
			NAME "Install"
			WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
			CONFIG Release

				"cp"
				"-f"
				"output/linux/Release/${REFLEX_ARCHITECTURE}/ReflexCLI/reflex"
				"${REFLEX_ROOT}/bin/tools/linux/reflex"

	if(REFLEX_PLATFORM_MACOS)

			COMMAND
				"codesign"

			CONFIG Release
			COMMAND

				"--sign"
